# Fixtures

Generated output, committed verbatim as evidence of what another tool actually emits.

Nothing here is hand edited, and nothing here is compiled by `tools/check.sh`.
`quarto-deck.typ` imports `@preview/fontawesome`, which lanterne does not depend on, so compiling it would pull in a dependency the package refuses to carry.
`tests/unit/test-quarto-fixture.typ` reproduces the shapes instead and asserts against those.

## Regenerating

`quarto-deck.typ` was generated by Quarto 1.9.38 from `quarto-deck.qmd`.

```bash
quarto render tests/fixtures/quarto-deck.qmd --to typst
```

`keep-typ` is set in the document's front matter, so the `.typ` survives the render.
The `.pdf` and the `.quarto` package cache the render leaves behind are ignored rather than committed.

After regenerating, read the new output and reconcile it with `tests/unit/test-quarto-fixture.typ`.
A shape that appears there and not in the test is a wrapper nobody has checked the registry against.
